messages:
Vik (Billing): Heads-up: Gateway alerted on a cluster of refunds for merchant VendorWave (acct_VW331). 7 refunds in 3 hours, several tied to vendor portal admin emails.
Neela (Risk): Any commonalities — same IP, admin user, or refund reason?
Vik (Billing): Two refunds show metadata: admin_user: 'vendor_admin_2' and note: 'manual portal refund'. Amounts vary ~$50-$400.
refund-bot: Alert: refund_pattern_anomaly for acct_VW331. Risk score 81%. Recommend hold payouts.
Arjun (FinOps): Hold next payout. Need to know if refunds were merchant-authorized or from a compromised credential.
Casey (Support): I messaged vendor via their support channel asking for the admin audit logs and any SSO logs. They replied: "We rotated API keys yesterday and had an emergency admin session." They attached a screenshot claiming it was internal ops.
Neela (Risk): Action items: 1) Request vendor admin audit trail (user, IP, timestamp); 2) Pull gateway webhook and API logs; 3) Check for new API keys or recent IAM changes. If compromised, we may reverse some refunds and pursue recovery.
Vik (Billing): Placed portal note: "Refund surge under review  possible compromised vendor admin" and tagged ledger entries lr_2005..lr_2011.
Arjun (FinOps): Provisional approval to reverse duplicates up to $2,000 if vendor provides signed incident report and audit logs. Otherwise keep hold.
Casey (Support): Vendor uploaded an admin audit CSV and two SSO logs showing a login from an unfamiliar IP. They're escalating to their security team.
Neela (Risk): Please upload those artifacts to /shared/finance/vendorwave/1915001234. I'll start drafting our dispute template and evidence bundle in case of chargebacks.
Legal: Reminder: if chargebacks arrive, we need chain-of-auth evidence and timeline showing merchant notified us and remedial steps. Keep all timestamps in UTC.
Vik (Billing): Will collate and ping here when evidence is uploaded.
refund-bot: Follow-up scheduled in 4 hours to re-evaluate risk score after artifacts arrive.
Neela (Risk): Thanks team  I'll aim to post a disposition within 6 hours of complete logs.
Arjun (FinOps): Noted. Holding payout until Neela confirms."
